Keep current addresses/stream and all semantics.

_bn_launch_key currently keys on input_3d.device.index, input_3d.dtype, output.dtype, weight None/bias None flags and per-tensor data_ptr alignment classes, but omits dtype/device of non-None weight, bias, save_mean, save_invstd, running_mean_out, running_var_out, running_mean, running_var.

hypothesis: Two calls with identical shapes/strides/scalars/addresses/alignment but different dtype (or device) for an optional or stats tensor share a cache key and reuse a launcher specialized for the wrong pointer element type, producing incorrect loads/stores or launch failure. Adding each tensor's (device, dtype) to the key prevents unsafe reuse while preserving fast-path hits for truly identical calls.

expected: Cache-hit fast path is only taken when every pointer argument has matching device and dtype; mismatched optional/stats dtypes fall back to the ordinary JIT path and remain correct. No change to kernel math, addresses, stream or outputs; negligible host-key overhead.
